svg.text: Generative model of PALM (stage A), as implemented
a ~ ZeroSumNormal(1.5²) over c; γc ~ N(0, 1); Akc ~ N(0, 1)
ηic = ac + γcTi + Σk XikAkc + sηεic
Program activity (per lineage l(c); l(c) = c by default)
κlp = τκ ℓ̃κlp zκlp, τκ ~ HalfCauchy(0.3), ℓκlp ~ HalfCauchy(1)
ℓ̃² = c²ℓ² / (c² + τ²ℓ²), c² = 1 (regularised horseshoe); β likewise
λp ~ HalfNormal(0.3); uip ~ N(0, 1); σl ~ HalfNormal(0.3)
δilp = κlp + βlpTi + Σk XikDklp + λpuip + σlzilp
Eicg = softmaxg( log Bcg + Σp δi,l(c),p Gpg )
mg = 1 in v2 (else exp(σmzg), σm ~ HalfNormal(0.3))
Bcg: atlas reference profiles (pseudo-bulk per donor, averaged)
Gpg: PROGENy weights, rescaled to median |w| = 1 per program
Li: library size; θg: moment estimate from the bulk,
shrunk to the median on the log scale (plug-in)
cell fraction ∝ πic / rc; rc = mean UMI per cell in the atlas
How the model is fitted and used: a modular (cut) pipeline
NUTS on a, γ, sη, κ, β, λ, σ, …;
cut: π's posterior draws pass forward; nothing feeds back into the model
(the model's own δ and β are not reported)
Inputs: bulk counts Y, atlas (reference specimens of other donors), programs G, group T, covariates X
atlas donors not used for B
with this study's fractions and design
Bayesian fit (A1–A2) for McFarland, Kang, Zhang;
PALM-lite (EM, no posterior) for Tahoe, Parse, COMBAT
